verdict.rationale: SolidJS explicitly advertises Resources and Suspense for treating server data as reactive state with responsive loading UIs (solid-gh-3), and general reactivity/SSR support is well documented (solid-gh-4). However, hands-on community feedback specifically warns to 'avoid Suspense... which can be very slow with no workaround' (solid-comm-15), directly contradicting the vendor's smooth-experience claim.
